description: Edit blog settings: `title` (otherwise the URL name is shown), `language` (BCP-47), `parentSiteUrl`, `analytics`, and brand `accentColor`, `logoUrl`, `faviconUrl` to match a main site. null clears any but `language`.

blog_id.description: Your blog's id, as returned by signup. Optional with an API key: it defaults to the key's blog, and any id you pass must be that blog. Required when the server runs without API keys.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key, any unique string (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the same key and identical arguments returns the first result instead of writing again; the same key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT. Scoped to your API key and this tool.

patch.description: Blog settings to change; omitted fields stay as they are.

accentColor.description: Brand color as #rrggbb, e.g. the main site's primary color. Used for links, the main-site button and the default favicon. Must be readable on the light page background (3:1); a refusal suggests a darker shade. null restores the theme's color.

domain.description: Site domain as registered in Plausible Cloud, e.g. "blog.example.com".

analytics.description: Analytics added to every page: any of `umami`, `plausible`, `googleAnalytics`. Replaces the whole analytics config; null removes it.

faviconUrl.description: Browser-tab icon URL (http/https): a square PNG, SVG or ICO, e.g. the main site's favicon. null restores the default icon (drawn in accentColor when set).

language.description: Default language for the blog as a BCP-47 tag, e.g. "en", "ru", "pt-BR".

logoUrl.description: Logo image URL (http/https), shown at the top of every page in place of the blog's name (which becomes its alt text). A wide wordmark works best; it is shown 32px tall. Use an uploaded image URL or the main site's logo. null shows the name again.

parentSiteUrl.description: URL (http/https) of the author's main site, linked from the blog. null removes it.

title.description: Display name shown as the blog's heading and in browser tabs, feeds and link previews, e.g. the project or person's name. 1–80 characters, one line. null removes it and the URL name is shown again.

name: update_blog

accentColor.description: Brand color, #rrggbb. null: the theme's color.

analytics.description: Absent when no analytics is configured.

language.description: The blog's default BCP-47 language tag.

logoUrl.description: null: the masthead shows the name.

title.description: Display name shown on the blog. null: the blog shows its name (or id) instead.

blog_url.description: The blog's public URL (its custom domain once one is verified). Posts live at {blog_url}{slug}/.

error.description: Present only on failure (isError: true). Success fields are absent then.

details.description: Extra context. Keys depend on the code.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do next.
